# Clavyra

> Clavyra is an AI and workflow automation agency based in Nairobi, Kenya, serving clients in Kenya and worldwide (remote). It builds "Digital Workers": narrow, end-to-end automated workflows wired directly into a client's CRM, calendar, messaging channels, payments, and accounting tools. It also builds fast, conversion-focused websites and landing pages connected to those workflows.

Founder: Tiffany Karanja. Contact: tiffany@clavyra.co, +254 769 025 156 (WhatsApp). Prices are in Kenyan shillings (KES) and include VAT.

## Core services

- [Speed-to-Lead & Database Reactivation](https://www.clavyra.co/services#speed-to-lead): Captures ad and website leads in under 60 seconds via WhatsApp (Kenya) or SMS and CRM webhooks (international), qualifies them, books calendar meetings, and re-engages old CRM lists. Pricing: From KES 25,000 setup + KES 3,000/month, including VAT.
- [Supervised Support & Inbox Triage](https://www.clavyra.co/services#support-triage): Connects to Gmail, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or WhatsApp, checks live status in a knowledge base or database, answers routine questions, and stages complex replies for 1-click human approval. Pricing: Custom quote after your audit.
- [Document-to-Ledger Reconciliation](https://www.clavyra.co/services#document-ledger): Extracts line items from supplier PDFs, receipts, and delivery notes, validates them against purchase orders, and syncs clean entries to QuickBooks, Xero, or ERPs. Pricing: Custom quote after your audit.
- [Websites & Conversion Systems](https://www.clavyra.co/services#websites): Fast, conversion-focused websites and landing pages integrated with booking calendars, M-Pesa or Stripe payments, CRM, and automated follow-up. Pricing: From KES 50,000, including VAT.

## Target markets

- Kenya: WhatsApp-first lead response on Meta's official WhatsApp Business Platform, M-Pesa payments, QuickBooks and Xero reconciliation. Based in Nairobi.
- International: remote delivery using SMS, CRM webhooks, Gmail, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero, and ERPs.
